components.name: Button
components.summary: Button is the commit control: five variants on a 28, 32 or 40px height, with the primary variant pressing 2px onto a hard lower edge.

components.name: Tag
components.summary: Tag is a 20px mono label for status, references and stage names.

components.name: Surface
components.summary: Surface is the card and pane container: a 1px bordered, 8px-radius panel on bg-surface.

components.name: Section
components.summary: Section is the ruled section header: a 1px charcoal rule, a mono index and eyebrow, and a t-h2 title.

components.name: Field
components.summary: Field is a labelled text input or textarea with a hint and an announced error.

components.name: Segmented
components.summary: Segmented is a compact radiogroup (filters) or tablist (panes) with roving tabindex.

components.name: Meter
components.summary: Meter is a 4px labelled progress bar toned by stage.

components.name: Pips
components.summary: Pips are small squares showing a level out of N, with a text equivalent.

components.name: Kbd
components.summary: Kbd is a mono key cap with a 2px lower edge for keyboard hints.

components.name: ProofCell
components.summary: ProofCell is the atomic mark: a 16, 24 or 32px square whose glyph says the stage and whose fill says how much evidence exists.

components.name: CapabilityTrail
components.summary: CapabilityTrail shows every capability and where it sits on the five stages: a ledger, a compact rail or a focus view of one capability.

components.name: ProjectEvidenceCard
components.summary: ProjectEvidenceCard presents one piece of work with the reasons to believe it: stage, skills, artifacts and review outcome.

components.name: SkillVerification
components.summary: SkillVerification is a verifiable claim, not a badge: it states the method, issuer, level and criteria behind a skill.

components.name: ProgressTimeline
components.summary: ProgressTimeline lists what the learner actually did, newest first, grouped by day.

components.name: LadderMark
components.summary: LadderMark is five rising bars ending in green, standing where a logo would sit.
